name: Homelab Infrastructure
description: Proxmox-based homelab running Kubernetes, Docker, and a full stack of self-hosted services. Automated with Terraform and Ansible.

name: GitOps Pipeline
description: ArgoCD-based GitOps workflow for deploying applications to Kubernetes clusters. Includes Helm charts, Kyverno policies, and automated rollbacks.

name: Home Automation
description: Home Assistant setup with Zigbee2MQTT, MQTT broker, and Tasmota devices. Automated lighting, climate, and security.

name: Identity & Access Management
description: Authentik-based identity provider with OIDC and LDAP integration. Centralized authentication for all homelab services.

name: Observability Stack
description: Grafana, Prometheus, and VictoriaMetrics stack for monitoring infrastructure and applications. ELK stack for log aggregation.

name: Network Infrastructure
description: MikroTik-based network with Tailscale and WireGuard tunnels. AdGuard for DNS filtering and split DNS configuration.
